_meta.name: Ledger arithmetic (public sample)
_meta.description: Public SAMPLE: on-chain accounting questions with one exact numeric answer each. Real sets stay private.

prompt: Bitcoin. A transaction spends three inputs of 0.50000000, 0.31250000 and 0.00470000 BTC and creates two outputs of 0.60000000 and 0.21700000 BTC. What fee does it pay, in satoshis? Answer with a whole number.

Bitcoin. A peel chain starts with one coin of 12.5 BTC. Each hop spends the current coin, pays 0.35 BTC to a deposit address, pays a fee of 0.00021 BTC, and sends the rest to a new change address. How many BTC sit in the change output after 17 hops? Answer with the number only.

Zcash. A wallet shields 250 ZEC and later empties its whole shielded balance in six withdrawals. Every withdrawal pays a 0.0001 ZEC fee out of the shielded balance. Five of the withdrawals are 40 ZEC each. What is the amount of the sixth? Answer with the number only.

A swap service pays deposit × rate × 0.995 − 0.00012 BTC, rounded down to 8 decimals. The rate is 0.00087 BTC per ZEC. How many BTC does it pay for a deposit of 842.6 ZEC? Answer with the number only.
Ethereum. A plain transfer uses 21,000 gas. The base fee is 34 gwei and the sender adds a priority fee of 2 gwei. How much ETH does the transfer cost in fees? Answer with the number only.

An address cluster received 14.2 ETH from exchange A, 3.75 ETH from bridge B, 22.05 ETH from mixer C and 5 ETH from wallet D. What percentage of its total inflow came from its largest counterparty? Answer with a number rounded to one decimal place.
